newsitem.title: USA: Biopool gets FDA nod for blood-clot kit.
newsitem.headline: Biopool gets FDA nod for blood-clot kit.

text.p: Biopool International Inc said on Friday it had received Food and Drug Administration approval to market its blood-coagulation kit.

The company said it had received 501(k) approval for its Spectrolyse Antithrombin-III (anti-Xa) Assay Kit, a test system designed to assess a patient's risk for developing blood clots, a precursor to a range of potentially life-threatening diseases.

It is the company's seventh product to receive FDA approval this year. The kit expands Biopool's line of in-vitro products dedicated to assessing and diagnosing the risks of clotting and bleeding disorders.
